quality_policy.precision: Relevant retrieved chunks divided by requested K. Empty slots count as zero.
quality_policy.recall: Relevant retrieved chunks divided by all unique relevant chunks in the 27-chunk artifact, per question.
quality_policy.mrr: Reciprocal of the first relevant rank through K, or zero if absent.
quality_policy.complete_evidence_coverage: One only if every required evidence unit has an alternative fully contained in one retrieved chunk.
quality_policy.relevance: Any positive overlap with an annotated alternative in actual source characters from the same document and section.
quality_policy.unanswerable: Excluded from quality averages. Returned result counts and latency are descriptive only.

latency_policy: Per-query wall clock using perf_counter_ns around index.search, including tokenization, scoring, sorting, and result materialization. Reuse index within a process. Exclude startup, artifact loading, index construction, validation, metric scoring and serialization. One evaluator process per K per repetition. No explicit warm-up.
